verdict.rationale: The evidence documents PostHog as an MCP server that external clients connect to, not as a client that can consume third-party MCP servers. PostHog Desktop appears in the list of compatible clients, but only for connecting to PostHog's own server. Nothing shows that users can register arbitrary external MCP servers so PostHog's agent can use their tools.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
